It is the second map that was added to the game. ==Description== A large area of industrial park land situated adjacent to the factory zone. The area houses a customs terminal, fuel storage facilities, offices, and dorms, as well as a variety of other infrastructure and buildings. ==Notes== {{PAGENAME}} is initially only accessible by [[Transits|transiting]]. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter [[Tour]]. ==Features== * Stationary weapons in the form of [[AGS-30 30x29mm automatic grenade launcher]]s and [[NSV Utyos 12.7x108 heavy machine gun]]s. * Be aware of [[Map of Tarkov#Border Snipers|Border Snipers]]! ==Usable Keys==
